veranderings.voor: Wat die dag vier, het egter van een koning na al die land se kulture gegroei.
veranderings.na: Wat op dié dag gevier word, het egter van een koning na al die land se kulture uitgebrei.
veranderings.rede: A day does not celebrate anything (people celebrate on it), and 'gegroei van ... na' calques English 'grew from ... to'; 'uitgebrei' is the natural Afrikaans verb for widening scope.

veranderings.blok: Erfenis wat jy nie kan vashou nie
veranderings.rede: Customs and songs are idiomatically 'oorgedra' to the next generation; 'oorgee' reads as handing over an object.

veranderings.voor: Gedigte wat iemand, soos 'n leier, se dade en eienskappe prys.
veranderings.na: Gedigte wat die dade en eienskappe van iemand, soos 'n leier, prys.
veranderings.rede: The inserted 'soos 'n leier' splits the possessive 'iemand ... se', which is awkward to read; the 'van' construction keeps the meaning and reads cleanly.
'Oor baie jare' for a span of time needs 'heen' in idiomatic Afrikaans; without it it echoes English 'over many years'.
Traditions are 'oorgedra' from generation to generation; this also matches the proposed wording in the first study block.

vlae.blok: Erfenis wat jy nie kan vashou nie
vlae.teks: Erfenis wat jy nie kan vashou nie
vlae.rede: The block heading says 'vashou' while the decided definition of nie-tasbare erfenis deliberately uses 'aanraak' (chosen over 'vashou' to mirror tasbare erfenis); a learner sees two verbs for one idea. Whether the heading should follow the definition is a writer's choice, so it is flagged, not changed.
